question: Which of the following has been declared as a Marine National Park by the Government of India for marine conservation in 1982?
solution:
The correct answer is **Gulf of Kutch**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The **Gulf of Kutch** was declared as a Marine National Park by the Government of India in **1982** for marine conservation.
 
• It is located on the southern coast of the **Kutch district** in the state of Gujarat.
 
• The park is known for its **rich marine biodiversity**, including coral reefs, mangroves, and various species of fish and marine animals.
